# Cranberry Bog Treasure Maps: Rewards Data Mining & All Locations

![Cranberry Bog Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations](/uploads/502_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![MonaLisa](/public/avatar_MonaLisa_ml1080.png) 

Treasure maps show **locations** with buried supplies in the game. To find the location, the **treasure map** must be in your inventory. The more treasure cards you have in your inventory for a location, the more can be dug up at the same time.

Treasure maps have **no carrying weight** and can therefore be stored in large quantities in the inventory. Supplies that can be unearthed include: **Weapons, Armor, Mods, Blueprints, Scrap, Chems, Food.**

In addition to the treasure maps and locations, there is also **data mining** with the possible rewards per area, as well as general rewards and rewards for teammates.

### Index

## Cranberry Bog treasure maps

### Cranberry Bog Treasure Map 01

North of the Watoga Transit Center is a bridge under which the mound with the treasure is located.

### Cranberry Bog Treasure Map 02

This treasure can be found behind the Ranger Lookout. There is a bridge east of it. There is a hill under the bridge.

### Cranberry Bog Treasure Map 03

Fast travel to Overgrown Sundew Grove. From there walk southwest past the grove to a withered tree next to a small lake. Right next to this tree is the hill.

### Cranberry Bog Treasure Map 04

Fast travel pylon V-13. Walk north along the railway line from pylon V-13. The hill lies on a pillar of the railway line between the two accessible pillars.
